content-max-width.$description: Maximum width of a readable page content column. Consumed by PageShell.Body's `constrained` prop as max-w-[var(--ds-layout-content-max-width)] (recorded in the source system's page-shell spec). Deliberately NOT given a THEME_GROUPS entry in sd.config.mjs, so no Tailwind utility is published for it — a governance decision in the source system, on the rationale that already withholds radius.card and spacing.fractional-step: a named utility would be an ENDORSED second way to obtain the same width, applied without the Body knowing, which is the duplication moving this value here exists to remove. Withheld means withheld from the public Tailwind namespace only: like every source token it still reaches generated/tokens.css and generated/tokens.ts, which is what lets the component read it and what carries it to the Figma export. Withholding removes the named utility; it cannot make the custom property unreachable, and page-shell.md §3.2 states that limit rather than claiming an enforcement this repository has no mechanism for. The value is moved, not re-decided — a dozen application pages in the source system hand-write the same pixel width today; whether that measure is the right one for a readable column is a separate design question (page-shell.md §12). The literal is written once in this file and nowhere else in the repository's source or token trees, which page-shell.md §11.4 enforces with a scoped grep — so it is not repeated in this description either.
